market_signals: we help team moves from fragmented decisions to complete experiences - from the first question to the last pixel.
We work with teams wherever the problem is
Your team's time, trust, and direction
We came in with a product. NetPurna helped us understand what problem we were actually solving. That reframe changed everything - the product, the roadmap, the team's confidence.
The Purna approach gave our team something we'd been missing - a shared language for how to make decisions. Not just a design handoff. An operating system for clarity.
I've worked with design studios that produce beautiful work. NetPurna produces useful work. The difference showed up immediately - in our users, in our metrics, in how our team thinks.

The teams we work with aren't struggling because they lack skill or resources. They're struggling because something in the experience - the product, the communication, the journey - doesn't yet make sense to the people using it.
That gap between what a team has built and what a user understands is where our work begins.
A team is building faster than they're understanding - shipping without a shared sense of what matters.
When we fix clarity first, everything else becomes easier. Adoption improves. Support load drops. Teams make faster decisions.
We help ambitious teams turn complexity into clarity -and turn user needs into experiences people understand, trust, and come back to.
Most teams don't struggle because they lack skill. They struggle because they are not fully aligned.
